current_interpretation: The draft treats NODI codes as requiring external interpretation. Rows without a numeric DMR_VALUE_NMBR in FY2025 are collected as no_numeric_result_case (186 rows). The nodi_code_semantics requirement lists only the empty string as known; all nonempty codes (C on 150 rows, 9 on 36 rows) are left UNINTERPRETED. The draft does not assign meanings such as 'no discharge' or 'monitoring not required' to either code.
why_it_matters: Purpose C must classify missing-result cases without treating blank data as compliance or violation. Without interpreted NODI semantics, 186 FY2025 cases cannot be placed into documented no-discharge, conditional-not-required, other no-data, or inadequate-evidence categories.
contracts_involved: nodi_code_semantics (INTERPRETED, relation no_numeric_result_case, field nodi_code, known only empty string)
alternatives_considered: Treat code C as establishing a documented no-discharge or no-data state
Treat code 9 as establishing that conditional monitoring was not required
Treat C and 9 as interchangeable missing-evidence markers
Leave all nonempty codes unresolved (current draft choice)
affected_computations: Purpose C row classification and unresolved list
remaining_uncertainty: What C vs 9 establish for missing-evidence classification; whether they are interchangeable.
